# Wenzel Grauth
## Creature 3

---

==Unique== ==Medium== ==Human== ==Humanoid==

Perception +7

Languages Common

Skills Arcana +9, Medicine +5, Occultism +9, Society +7, Stealth +7

Str +0, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +1

---

AC 17; Fort +8, Ref +9, Will +10

HP 30

---

Speed 25 feet

Melee `[one-action]` staff +7 (two-hand d8), Damage 1d4 bludgeoning

Arcane Prepared Spells DC 20, attack +10; 2nd false vitality,
mirror image, spectral hand; 1st grim tendrils, mystic armor, summon undead;
Cantrips (2nd) electric arc, message, shield, telekinetic projectile

Grave-Cut Raising (concentrate, manipulate) Grauth spends a minute over a
body in wet ground and it gets up. He can hold at most six at once, and the
sixth is always worse than the first — this is why the wave that arrives late
is the one that has mud in its mouth and no boots.

Kindling (manipulate) Grauth straps a case of alchemist's fire under a
raising's ribs and runs a slow cord to the sternum. It takes him an hour a
corpse and he hates doing it. The raising is destroyed by its own delivery,
which is the part he cannot stop turning over: he was raised to think of a
body as a thing you keep.

description.value:
You augment your flesh with the energies typically used to manipulate the undead. You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Vitality}

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}
Imported from a Saeroth statblock. Add the spell's full text before play.

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

You ward yourself with shimmering magical energy, gaining a +1 item bonus to AC and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. While wearing mystic armor, you use your unarmored proficiency to calculate your AC.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.qkwb5DD3zmKwvbk0]{Spell Effect: Mystic Armor}

Heightened (4th) You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws.

Heightened (6th) The item bonus to AC increases to +2, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws.

Heightened (8th) The item bonus to AC increases to +2, and you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws.

Heightened (10th) The item bonus to AC increases to +3, and you gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws.

You summon a creature that has the undead trait and whose level is -1 to fight for you.

Heightened As listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{summon} trait.

An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

duration.value: until the start of your next turn

description.value:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

---

Flaying Grasp `[two-actions]` Requirements The skinwright's claws are free; Effect The skinwright attempts two claw Strikes against one target. If both hit and deal damage, it attempts an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC.
Critical Success The target takes 2d6 persistent bleed damage and is frightened 2. The skinwright claims their skin, which it can later use with Wear Skin.
Success The target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

Wear Skin `[one-action]` (manipulate) Requirements The skinwright is holding a claimed skin and isn't already wearing one; Effect The skinwright dons the skin, appearing as a living member of that skin's ancestry. This automatically defeats a Perception check to determine its true creature type, and it gains a +2 status bonus to its Deception DC against attempts to see through the disguise. Wearing a skin grants 10 temporary Hit Points. When those run out, the skin is ruined and falls away at no action cost, with the same effect as Cast Off the Skin.

Cast Off the Skin `[one-action]` (emotion, fear, mental, visual) Requirements The skinwright is wearing a skin; Effect The skinwright destroys the worn skin and reverts to its true form. Each creature within 30 feet currently observing it must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). A creature already frightened by this ability today is temporarily immune.

# The Cream Man
## Creature 1

---

==Medium== ==Elemental== ==Water==

Perception +7; darkvision

Skills Athletics +9, Stealth +5

Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha +0

---

AC 15; Fort +10, Ref +5, Will +7

HP 26; Immunities bleed, paralyzed, poison, sleep; Weaknesses fire 5

---

Speed 15 feet

Melee `[one-action]` slam +9, Damage 1d6+5 bludgeoning

Cream Fill `[two-actions]` Effect The Cream Man Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of any creatures in its path. Any creature its size or smaller whose space it moves through can attempt a DC 17 Reflex save. A creature unable to act automatically critically fails.
Success The creature is pushed aside, or to the end of the Cream Man's movement, its choice.
Failure The creature is engulfed. It's grabbed, slowed 1, and must hold its breath or start suffocating. It takes 1d6+3 bludgeoning damage now and at the end of each of its turns while engulfed, and can attempt to Escape (DC 17) to break free. An engulfed creature can only attack the Cream Man with unarmed attacks or weapons of light Bulk or less, and the Cream Man is off-guard to those attacks. A single hit dealing 8 or more piercing or slashing damage lets an engulfed creature cut itself free on the spot. A creature that gets free by any method is sickened 1, or sickened 2 if it spent two or more of its own turns inside him, as its stomach objects to the sudden weight of cream. The Cream Man can hold as many creatures as fit in its space.
